name: seeker-thewhiteh4t
description: Authorized local-lab inspection, diagnostics, privacy hardening, and auditing workflows for thewhiteh4t/seeker.

interface.longDescription: Inspect, configure, test, harden, and troubleshoot thewhiteh4t/seeker in transparent, authorized local or lab environments. Seeker Lab covers CLI and template inspection, Python/PHP diagnostics, synthetic localhost testing, sensitive-artifact review, privacy hardening, data-flow auditing, and upstream comparison. Runtime collection is limited to localhost, the user's own devices, synthetic fixtures, or clearly consenting participants. It does not assist deceptive or covert collection against third parties.
capabilities: Explain CLI flags, environment variables, and templates
Diagnose Python, PHP, dependency, port, and PID failures
Audit browser, PHP, Python, CSV, KML, and outbound data flow
Redact sensitive Seeker artifacts before review
Review templates for transparent lab use
Compare a checkout with upstream source
Report exact execution evidence and residual risks
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Seeker checkout and tell me what is configured or broken.
Run a safe localhost smoke test using synthetic fixture data.
Audit this Seeker checkout for privacy, data-flow, and runtime risks.

publication.release_notes: Fix portable OpenAI extension namespace and rebuild a minimal upload package.
